explanation: On January 13, 2026, a code-only Stoneharrow invoice was mistaken for Tamsin, but Marcus confirmed it was the Carolinas mill invoice. That mill is Thornbury Cloth Co. (formerly Orrin Mills), whose code collides with Tamsin Cold Chain's TCC. The wiki cites D019 for this exchange but does not record the chat participants, so the attribution to Marcus and Ilse's chat is an assumption.
